scenes.text: You may have changed the direction today, but the reflection you are seeing was built from who you were yesterday.

scenes.text: then getting mad because the weeds did not respectfully move out.

scenes.text: So do you.

scenes.text: The question is not whether the old reflection is still there.

scenes.text: The question is: are you still feeding it?

scenes.text: Are you still waking up and rehearsing the same complaints?

scenes.text: Because the world listens less to what you say you want than to what you repeatedly expect.
